name: How thick should a concrete walkway be?

mainEntity.name: How thick should a concrete walkway be?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most residential concrete walkways, a thickness of 4 inches is generally sufficient to withstand foot traffic and light loads without cracking, assuming a properly prepared sub-base. However, for areas that might experience occasional heavier loads, such as a utility access path, a 5-6 inch thickness might be recommended. We will assess your specific usage and soil conditions to recommend the optimal thickness for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most residential concrete walkways require 4 inches of thickness; heavier loads may necessitate 5-6 inches for durability.
